prompt.text: Complete this bounded research task exactly: compare JSON and YAML for human-edited configuration. Call research_plan_start with exactly two branches, JSON and YAML, each budget {searches:0, reads:1}. The JSON branch must read https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc8259; the YAML branch must read https://yaml.org/. Immediately dispatch one research-planner child per branch. Each child must web_read its assigned URL once and branch_plan done with exactly one source lead and one combined claim that states one property and one limitation, using the original URL. When both reports are terminal, the parent must web_read those two lead URLs, record exactly one parent-validated evidence card per lead using the exact claim text, then call plan_settle with a summary shorter than 240 characters. Do not search, delegate again, add extra leads, or broaden the question. If a source fails or its quote cannot support the combined claim, mark only that branch deferred with value, risk, and rationale.

negative_control.text: What are the two JSON structural types? Give a short answer from one official source.
